prediction: see prediction.json, written before the first fold

clock.below_1200: clock artifact; reject timing, never call regression

host_cpu_witness.foreign: any process outside the run session (own=false)
host_cpu_witness.added: 2026-09-16, after run baseline1 was excluded for an overlapping git pack the device-holder census could not see
host_cpu_witness.older_runs: runs without ambient.jsonl reduce to recorded=false and are not rejected on this criterion

quiet.co_tenancy: a sibling worker may hold a DIFFERENT card. Refused only on the assigned node. Co-tenants are recorded per label and carried equally by both interleaved arms; a contended session is reported as contended, never as a regression.

accuracy.metric: maximum independently superposed domain all-atom float64 Kabsch RMSD, split after residue 298; also report whole-chain all-atom
accuracy.ab_rule: arm B structure is scored against the A0 reference and REPORTED against the size bar with the seed floor beside it. It is not an automatic kill: this campaign's rule is accuracy, not bit-exactness.

kill: wrong opened node, containment change or boot change
foreign device holder or quiet/lock timeout
clock read error, wrong clock or coverage gap
same-seed structural deviation over size bar
foreign host CPU process at or above 20% of a core during an accepted fold
bare: Production wheel, no Tracy/graph/observer/module timers/sum profiling. Synchronize before monotonic start and after predict_one including CIF writing.
unmeasured: No device-cycle census, per-op budget, CPU removable cost, ceiling, upstream accuracy, or cross-run speedup.
node: 1 (ASIC 380F6B89681D36A4, p300c, fw 19.15.0.0). Every campaign number of record is node 0.
arms: interleaved within one warmed device context; arm A is the untouched default and is also this node's anchor
